# FSI Agent Governance Framework

> A governance framework of 79 controls across four pillars (Security, Management, Reporting, and SharePoint) that helps US financial services organizations govern Microsoft 365 AI agents (Microsoft Copilot Studio and Agent Builder) and supports compliance with FINRA, SEC, SOX, GLBA, OCC, and Federal Reserve recordkeeping and model-risk obligations.

The framework organizes controls into three governance zones (Personal Productivity, Team Collaboration, and Enterprise Managed) and a three-layer documentation model (Framework -> Controls -> Playbooks). It is written for Microsoft 365 administrators, compliance officers, and AI governance leads. This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org/).

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://judeper.github.io/FSI-AgentGov/): Overview of the FSI Agent Governance Framework and how to navigate the documentation site.
- [Framework Overview](https://judeper.github.io/FSI-AgentGov/framework/): Governance principles, zones, regulatory context, and operating model.
- [Control Explorer](https://judeper.github.io/FSI-AgentGov/controls/explorer/): Interactive, filterable catalog of all 79 controls by pillar, zone, and regulation.
- [Governance Readiness Assessment](https://judeper.github.io/FSI-AgentGov/assessment/): Browser-based self-assessment that scores control maturity with no data leaving the device.
- [Regulatory Mappings](https://judeper.github.io/FSI-AgentGov/reference/regulatory-mappings/): Cross-reference of the 79 controls to US financial-services regulations.
